supersedes_nothing: the base preregistration at 0e78666589ae stands as written; this addendum records what an independent CLAIM review broke in it, BEFORE any code was written against it, and what changed as a result
reviewer: a fresh Claude agent given the preregistration, the NEMO source and legoESM's transcription, and nothing else; codex is unavailable on this account

F1.finding: PR4's ELIMINATION IS INVALID AS WRITTEN.  Neither arm (b) nor arm (c) ever executes legoESM's right-hand-side construction: the production solve takes the RHS as an argument (implicit_solver.py:417-424) and the RHS is built at ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:11977-11988.  Both arms can read 0 cells unequal with the RHS build arbitrarily wrong, and PR4 then names that same RHS its own second-ranked suspect and concludes 'operand' by elimination.
F1.disposition: ADOPTED.  A fourth arm was added (rhs_content) and the model's own RHS row is reported UNMEASURED with its reason rather than omitted.

F2.finding: A LIVE FALLBACK SUBSTITUTES A DIFFERENT SYSTEM AND BOTH ARMS BYPASS IT.  _nemo_tracer_content_rhs is None (ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:11943) unless tracer_combine == 'thickness_weighted' (:11949, :11988); otherwise the literal solve receives _content_t = T_solve_in * dz_cell (:10220-10221), which is e3t(Kaa)*T_expl, not NEMO's e3t(Kbb)*T(Kbb) + p2dt*e3t(Kmm)*RHS (trazdf.F90:272, :276-277).
F2.disposition: ADOPTED, and MEASURED.  Building the three cards prints tracer_combine = 'concentration' on GYRE-zco, LOCK_EXCHANGE-zco and OVERFLOW-zps, with zdf_implicit_solver_evaluation = 'nemo_literal' on all three.  So on the very card under investigation the literal trazdf matrix is fed the concentration form and the content builder -- whose own docstring at :2179-2182 says it exists so the literal matrix can consume NEMO's content RHS -- is never selected.

F3.finding: PR5 IS RIGHT FOR THE WRONG REASON.  GYRE's initial density is NOT horizontally uniform: usrdef_istate.F90:68 and :76 each end in * ptmask(ji,jj,jk), so land columns carry T=0, S=0 and a different rhd.  ah_wslp2 is zero because every horizontal density difference in ldf_slp is MASKED (ldfslp.F90:167-168, :181-182) and because the land rim sits outside [ntsi,ntei] at jpiglo=36 with nn_hls=2.  The VALUE claim survives; the MECHANISM is false and gives the wrong answer on any card with interior topography.
F3.disposition: ADOPTED as a correction.  PR5's threshold and falsifier are unchanged; its stated mechanism is REPLACED by the masked-difference one, and it is recorded that the mechanism does not transfer to ORCA2.

F4.finding: r0_4 cites ocean.output:664, which is the lateral diffusive velocity rn_Ud.  'Rotated laplacian operator (standard)' is at :667.
F4.disposition: ADOPTED.  The citation is :667.  Every other cited line verified: 158, 553, 557, 561, 562, 568, 650, 655, 657.

F5.finding: r0_8's istate citation stops one line short of the term that falsifies it: the statements start at :63 and :70, the * ptmask factor is at :68 and :76.

F6.finding: PR3 IS VACUOUS ON legoESM's ONLY MASKING DIFFERENCE.  legoESM overwrites the dry diagonal with 1.0 and multiplies each face by interface_wet; NEMO does neither, its dry diagonal being e3t_3d (ppsrc trazdf.f90:233).  GYRE has no dry cell in the scored box (usrdef_zgr.F90:201-205, flat bottom, rim in halo), so PR3 cannot exercise it and its verdict will not transfer to ORCA2.
F6.disposition: ADOPTED.  The gate now reports NAMED DEVIATIONS with the measured condition under which each is inert, and a synthetic record with a dry bottom flips two of them LIVE and turns the assembly rows red, so the report is non-vacuous.

F7.finding: PR3's BOTTOM ROW PASSES BY ACCIDENT.  NEMO's zws(jpkm1) = -p2dt*zwt(jpk)/e3w(jpk,Kmm) (trazdf.F90:220) enters the last solved row's diagonal; legoESM's upper is a hard zero there.  They agree only because avt(:,:,jpk) = 0, and the gate could not distinguish correct from accidentally correct.
F7.disposition: ADOPTED.  The condition is now a named deviation carrying its own measured number, max |zwt_mix| at jk = jpk.

F8.finding: PR6 HAS AN UNSCORED RANGE.  The clamp at trazdf.F90:90 runs over ALL jk including jpk, which tra_zdf_imp never assigns (its loops end at jpkm1), so a clamp at jpk would be invisible to a gate that scores 1..jpkm1.  PR6 is also only meaningful if the pre-clamp column is an independent Fortran copy rather than a rebuild.
F8.disposition: ADOPTED.  The clamp rows score the WHOLE column, 1..jpk.  The pre-clamp column IS an independent copy, taken inside tra_zdf_imp after the third recurrence and therefore before the clamp, so the arm is not circular.

prediction_changes.PR4: ITS RANKING IS REFUTED, before the record exists, by a Rule-10 measurement of the built cards rather than by an argument.  The claim's SHAPE stands -- arms (b) and (c) still decide whether the owner is inside the transcription -- but the ranked first suspect is no longer avt.  It is the RIGHT-HAND SIDE, and not merely as 'the same expression with a different association': on this card legoESM's literal solve is fed a DIFFERENT expression entirely.  New ranking: (1) the RHS, because tracer_combine resolves to 'concentration'; (2) avt; (3) the e3t(Kaa)/e3w(Kmm) substitutions.
prediction_changes.PR5: mechanism replaced per F3; threshold and falsifier unchanged
prediction_changes.PR6: scored over 1..jpk rather than 1..jpkm1 per F8

PR8_new.claim: The content-RHS builder thickness_weighted_tracer_content, given NEMO's own operands mapped onto its slots, reproduces NEMO's dumped rhs_T and rhs_S.  The ONLY difference the mapping leaves is the ASSOCIATION of the triple product: NEMO writes p2dt*e3t(Kmm)*T(Krhs), the builder computes e3t(Kmm)*(p2dt*T(Krhs)).
PR8_new.threshold: 0 cells unequal on T and on S
PR8_new.falsifier: any cell unequal -> flipping tracer_combine to 'thickness_weighted' would NOT be bit-exact on its own, and round 36 needs the association fixed as well
PR8_new.why_it_matters: round 36 cannot flip that switch on evidence it does not have; this arm is that evidence

not_adopted_as_stated.signed_zero: not a review finding -- it came out of RUNNING the new gate on the synthetic twin.  NEMO's zwi at the surface row and its zws at the bottom row are NEGATIVE zeros (-p2dt*0.0/e3w with zwt(:,1)=0 at trazdf.F90:204, :219-220) where legoESM writes POSITIVE zeros.  Recorded as its own status AT-BAR-SIGNED-ZERO with its own count, not folded into AT-BAR and not called DEBT, because the bits differ and no arithmetic result does.
